note: Service landing pages (general, no city). One entry per page: slug, H1, title, description, form chip value (must match a chip in services.json), photos (project ids from projects.json, in display order), handle (What we handle list, only items the old WordPress site supports), faq (extra questions), published. No prices, timelines, warranties or claims. services.json holds the form chips and pills. Five pages in total: kitchen-remodeling, bathroom-remodeling, deck-building, adu-garage-conversion (was adu-construction), roofing. faq: What kitchen projects do you take on?
Kitchen remodeling, including layouts, cabinets, countertops, flooring and finishes, up to a full kitchen remodel. Tell us what you have in mind in the form on this page or call {{PHONE}}.
Can you remodel just part of my kitchen?
Yes. Some people want new cabinets or counters, others want the whole room redone. We talk through the scope with you in the free consultation.
How much does a kitchen remodel cost?
It depends on the size of the kitchen, the materials you choose and how much of the room changes. We go over it with you in the free consultation.
How long does a kitchen remodel take?
It depends on the scope of the work. We plan it with you in the free consultation.
What should I have ready for the free consultation?
Photos of your kitchen, any ideas or examples you like, and a rough idea of your budget and timing. If you do not have all of that yet, that is fine. Nothing else is required.
Which areas do you serve?
We are licensed in Washington, fully insured and bonded, and we work in Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Seattle, Issaquah, Sammamish, Renton, Kent, Bothell, Tacoma, Federal Way and Des Moines.

faq: What ADU and garage conversion projects do you take on?
Backyard ADUs and DADUs and garage conversions, from planning the space to the finishes. Tell us what you have in mind in the form on this page or call {{PHONE}}.
What is the difference between an ADU, a DADU and a garage conversion?

An ADU is an accessory dwelling unit on your property. A DADU is a detached ADU, usually in the backyard. A garage conversion turns an existing garage into living space. We help you decide which fits your property in the free consultation.
Can a basement become an ADU?

Many homeowners turn a basement into an accessory dwelling unit. Specific regulations and codes must be followed, so talk it through with us in a free consultation. Use the form on this page or call {{PHONE}}.
How much does an ADU or garage conversion cost?
It depends on the size of the project, the materials you choose and how much changes. We go over it with you in the free consultation.

It depends on the scope of the work. We plan it with you in the free consultation.

We are licensed in Washington, fully insured and bonded, and we work in Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Seattle, Issaquah, Sammamish, Renton, Kent, Bothell, Tacoma, Federal Way and Des Moines.
